name: dune-flow
title: Dune Flow
description: Smooth B-spline stacked area flow showing what a stream was made of and when the waves came.

meta.question: What made up the flow over time, and when were the waves?
meta.whenToUse: Daily composition of a volume stream (issues by priority, requests by tier) where the trend shape matters more than exact per-day spikes.
meta.antiUse: When readers must read exact values off the chart — the B-spline deliberately does not pass through the data points (raw values live only in the tooltip).
